encryption.title: Encryption
encryption.description: Envelope encryption gives every record its own data key (DEK) wrapped by your key-encryption key (KEK). This enables per-record crypto-shredding for GDPR erasure. Changing the mode runs a background migration of existing records; reads stay correct throughout.

models.title: Models
models.description: The AI models this site uses, the order they are tried in for each task, and what they cost. A site without its own providers uses the instance default.
models.forbidden: Only administrators of this site can manage its models.
models.loadFailed: Failed to load the model providers.

models.confirmDelete: Delete the model provider “{{name}}”? Its usage stays in the ledger.
models.probeStale: The provider changed while it was being probed: probe it again.
models.newProviderBody: An OpenAI-compatible service: DeepSeek, Qwen, Kimi, GLM, or any other with a /chat/completions endpoint.
models.apiRootHint: Without /chat/completions, credentials or a query string.
models.apiKeyHint: Stored encrypted. It is never shown again — only a mask.
models.failoverBody: For each task, the providers to try in order: the first is the primary, the others are backups. A task without a list uses the default list, then the instance default.
models.currencyNote: Every provider's prices are in this currency; it cannot change once the site has model usage.
models.carriedOver: Still open from earlier months: {{list}} — counted against this month until reconciled.
models.reconcileBody: Requests that were (or may have been) sent without a usage report: timeouts, dropped connections, errors such as rate limits. Their reservation stays against the budget until you enter the cost from the provider's console or invoice, or confirm it was not billed.

updates.title: Updates
updates.description: Opt in to read the public HeoPress release manifest and show admins when a new version is available.
updates.checksBody: When enabled, Studio periodically sends an anonymous GET request to {{url}}. The manifest includes the latest stable and edge versions, release date, changelog URL, minimum safe upgrade version, and a migration-warning flag.
updates.privacy: Studio does not send tokens, site IDs, hostnames, extension lists, or other sensitive data. Telemetry is not part of this setting and must be opted into separately if introduced.
updates.current: Current channel {{channel}}; latest manifest version is {{version}}.
updates.hint: Enable checks and click “Check now” to read the public release manifest.
updates.disabled: Update checks are disabled. Studio will not contact the release manifest endpoint until an admin opts in.
updates.guard1: Studio only displays “new version available” notices with upgrade-guide and changelog links.
updates.guard2: The UI cannot restart services, apply migrations, or trigger an upgrade workflow.
updates.guard3: Telemetry requires a separate opt-in and is intentionally not sent by this manifest check.

uploads.title: Uploads
uploads.description: Choose which file types and sizes are accepted. These limits are enforced on the server for every upload — files that don't match their declared type, exceed the size cap, or embed active/script content are rejected before they reach storage.
uploads.pickerNote: The picker will offer: <mono>{{extensions}}</mono>. Uploads are content-sniffed (magic bytes) and served as downloads with <mono>nosniff</mono>, so a file cannot masquerade as an image or run as script.

errors.size: Enter a valid maximum size in MB.
errors.types: Select at least one allowed file type.
errors.forbidden: Saving upload settings requires site admin access.
